notes.title: Fix by Day, Steal by Night!
notes.content:
[h2]Time to switch gears - literally! 🛠️🕶️[/h2]

This bundle brings together two unique experiences that are all about precision and strategy. By day, you’ll work on detailed repairs and customizations. By night, step into the shadows and test your skills as a master thief.

From fixing vehicles to breaking into them, this bundle offers a mix of excitement, creativity, and adrenaline. Ready to take on the challenge?

[b]Have fun and enjoy the games! 🚗✨[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49504/

notes.title: Get ready for the Luxury Houses DLC and patch 1.7
notes.content:
Hello there.
It's been a bit since the last update but we are finally ready!
In 3 days you'll be able to steal again like in good old times.

Apart from the paid DLC the patch 1.7 will include a brand new location, farm. We also improved some visuals, animations. Lot of bugs had been fixed.

[b]The contracts:[/b]
We introduced a new system called "Contracts". It allows players to finish side missions without impacting the main story. Players can switch contracts on the home computer at any moment.
Steal specific items to earn reputation points for different clients.

This system will allow us to add more side content in the future.

See you all in 3 days!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30583878/9f9a329994620bc52082b8fb1d55c886c80e93a8.png[/img]
